story.fullStory:
The Animals's "It's My Life" reached #23 on the Billboard Hot 100. "It's My Life" is a song written by New York City songwriters Roger Atkins and Carl D'Errico.

The song peaked at #23 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 12 weeks on the chart.

It's My Life was released in 1965.

"It's My Life" is a song written by New York City songwriters Roger Atkins and Carl D'Errico.
The song was originally performed by English R&B band The Animals, who released it as a single in October 1965 (see 1965 in music).
Also released on two EPs that same year, the song first appeared on an album in 1966, on The Best of the Animals.
